Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Join activities to assays and compound_structures via molecule_dictionary. Filter for assay CHEMBL1217644 and exact measurements (standard_relation = '='). Exclude rows where standard_value or standard_relation is null. Return rows sorted by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
